capsuleTopic.title: Elijah
capsuleTopic.subtitle: Drought · provision · Carmel · Horeb · kings · mantle · memory · return
capsuleTopic.orientation: Follow Elijah from his sudden appearance before Ahab through drought, hidden provision, Carmel, wilderness exhaustion, Horeb, royal confrontation, succession, departure, and later Scripture memory.
capsuleTopic.trailPrompt: Trace Elijah through words and actions that affect households, weather, worship, kings, prophetic succession, later expectation, Gospel scenes, and apostolic argument.

payload.description: Hold vineyard accusation, Ahab’s response and death, Joram on Naboth’s field, Jezebel’s death, and the destruction of the royal house in order.

nodes.note: The LORD sends Elijah to Ahab in the seized vineyard, where accusation and judgment answer Naboth’s death and the taking of his land.
nodes.title: Elijah finds Ahab in Naboth’s vineyard

nodes.note: After the narrator describes Ahab’s evil, Ahab tears his clothes, fasts, and goes softly; the LORD tells Elijah that the announced disaster will be delayed.
nodes.title: Ahab humbles himself after the word

nodes.note: Ahab dies after the battle at Ramoth Gilead, and blood from his chariot is washed at the pool of Samaria where dogs lick it, according to the LORD’s word.
nodes.title: Ahab’s blood is washed at Samaria

nodes.note: Jehu meets Joram and Ahaziah near Naboth’s property, strikes Joram, and orders his body cast onto the field while recalling the burden spoken against Ahab.
nodes.title: Joram falls on Naboth’s field

nodes.note: Jezebel is thrown from the window and later cannot be buried as intended; Jehu identifies the outcome with the LORD’s word spoken by Elijah.
nodes.title: Jezebel’s death recalls Elijah’s word

nodes.note: Jehu’s letters, the deaths of Ahab’s sons, and the destruction of those remaining in Samaria are framed as fulfillment of the LORD’s word spoken through Elijah.

nodes.note: Elijah tells Ahab that rain is coming, bows on Carmel while his servant looks seven times, and runs ahead as the sky darkens and rain falls.
